About the author

Muhammad Saeed Qureshi is an independent author and publisher from Multan, Pakistan, born on March 7, 1998, and a verified Goodreads Author. He writes fiction — including the My Own Mistress novel series and its sequel My Own Survival — and translates and edits classic works on physical education, including Friedrich Ludwig Jahn’s The German Art of Gymnastics and Georges Hébert’s The Natural Method. He also creates practical, reader-friendly books: large-print puzzle books for seniors, beautifully designed coloring books for children such as Magical Baby Animals and Magical Ocean World, and inspiring home interior guides. His goal is simple: useful books, honestly made, that readers return to. All of his books are available on Amazon.

Frequently asked questions

Who is Muhammad Saeed Qureshi?

Muhammad Saeed Qureshi is an independent author and publisher from Multan, Pakistan, born on March 7, 1998. He is a verified Goodreads Author who writes fiction, translates and edits classic books, and publishes coloring books, large-print puzzle books and practical guides.

What books has Muhammad Saeed Qureshi written?

His books include the novels My Own Mistress and My Own Survival, the translated and edited classics The German Art of Gymnastics by Friedrich Ludwig Jahn and The Natural Method by Georges Hébert, children’s coloring books including Magical Baby Animals and Magical Ocean World, Large Print Islamic Word Search for Seniors, Large Print Sudoku for Seniors, and Modern Home Interior.

Where can I buy books by Muhammad Saeed Qureshi?

Books by Muhammad Saeed Qureshi are available on Amazon. My Own Mistress, the first book in his novel series, is available on Amazon, and his author photo and book list also appear on Amazon Author Central and Goodreads.

How can I contact Muhammad Saeed Qureshi?

For questions about a book, publishing, or collaborations, you can connect with Muhammad Saeed Qureshi on Facebook through the contact section below.

In what order should I read the My Own Mistress series?

Start with My Own Mistress, the first book in the series, then continue with My Own Survival, which is Book 2 and the direct sequel.

Is My Own Mistress available as an eBook and paperback?

Yes. My Own Mistress by Muhammad Saeed Qureshi is available on Amazon as an eBook and in paperback.

What ages are the coloring books by Muhammad Saeed Qureshi for?

Bold and Easy Cute Animals is made for kids ages 2–6, Magical Baby Animals and Magical Ocean World are for kids ages 3–8, and Cozy Christmas Moments is a bold and easy coloring book for adults and teens.

Which translated classics has Muhammad Saeed Qureshi published?

He has translated and edited Friedrich Ludwig Jahn’s The German Art of Gymnastics, a complete system of physical training, and Georges Hébert’s The Natural Method, a practical guide to physical education, both in modern illustrated editions.
